title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
about: Grand Union DTP invites expressions of interest for ESRC Postdoctoral Fellowships starting 1 October 2027, based at Brunel, The Open University or Oxford. Expression-of-interest documents go to the relevant department by 16:00 on 11 January 2027; full applications follow via departments by 23 March 2027.
requirements: PhD awarded, or viva passed with minor corrections, by the deadline
No more than 12 months of active postdoctoral experience
card_alt: Card for the Postdoctoral Fellowships at Grand Union DTP, United Kingdom, expression-of-interest deadline 11 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London, not a host university.
